experiments.notes: GPTScan adapted for NFT vulnerabilities. 4-phase independent pipeline. Zero-shot. ~16 API calls/contract. Results in results/gptscan_gpt4omini_results.csv.
GPTScan with DeepSeek-V3 via OpenRouter. Best macro F1 overall. Results backed up in results/gptscan_deepseek_summary.json.
5-step NFT-specific pipeline. Few-shot at Step 3. ~69 API calls/contract causes severe error propagation. Results in results/nftscan_results.csv.
Same 5-step pipeline as NFT-Scan gpt-4o-mini but with DeepSeek-V3 via OpenRouter. +71% macro F1 over gpt-4o-mini variant. Results in results/nftscan_deepseek_results.csv.

Slither oracle feeds ALL detector findings as structured expert report to every LLM phase (~7.8 API calls/contract vs 69 for NFT-Scan). Key results: ERC721_Reentrancy recall=1.000 (perfect) but precision=0.177 — LLM defers too heavily to Slither's reentrancy signal (206/400 flagged, only 44 true). First method to detect Risky_Mutable_Proxy (F1=0.200; all others=0.000). Public_Burn=0.000 — Slither has no access-control signal for burn functions. Results in results/augscan_v2_results.csv.
Hybrid pipeline: Slither pre-analysis (Step 0) + NFT-Scan steps + three-tier ensemble. Script: pipeline/nft_scan_pp.py.

Script: pipeline/slither_ablation.py. Key finding: Slither achieves 95.5% recall on ERC721_Reentrancy but only 20.4% precision — flags 206/400 contracts as reentrancy (only 44 truly are). Zero detection on all NFT-specific classes (Unlimited_Minting, Missing_Requirements, Public_Burn, Risky_Mutable_Proxy). Confirms static analysis alone cannot replace LLM-based detection. Slither's high-recall reentrancy signal is ideal for LLM-filtered hybrid (NFT-AugScan / NFT-Scan++) where LLM resolves false positives.

key_findings: NFT-GPTScan (DeepSeek-V3) achieves best overall macro F1=0.2677 — independent phases avoid error propagation from multi-step pipelines
NFT-AugScan-v2 (Slither Oracle) ranks 3rd at macro F1=0.1978, outperforming NFT-Scan DeepSeek (0.1852) with far fewer API calls (~7.8 vs 69/contract)
NFT-AugScan-v2 is the ONLY method to detect Risky_Mutable_Proxy (F1=0.200 vs 0.000 for all others) — Slither's proxy detectors provide signal unavailable to pure-LLM approaches

NFT-AugScan-v2 achieves perfect recall=1.000 on ERC721_Reentrancy but precision=0.177 — LLM over-defers to Slither's reentrancy signal (206/400 flagged, only 44 true), suppressing Public_Burn and other classes
ERC721_Reentrancy blind spot: GPTScan scores F1=0.000 (LLMs cannot detect callback-based reentrancy without static signal); Slither oracle fixes recall but introduces precision problem
Public_Burn=0.000 across all hybrid methods — Slither has no access-control signal for burn functions; requires dedicated burn-pattern detector or few-shot examples
DeepSeek-V3 consistently outperforms gpt-4o-mini: +8.8% on GPTScan, +71% on NFT-Scan

Slither ablation (novel contribution): NFTDefects paper tested 6 static tools but NOT Slither. Our ablation shows Slither achieves 95.5% recall but 20.4% precision on reentrancy — flags 206/400 contracts. Zero detection on all NFT-specific classes.

Complementary blind spots across methods: GPTScan excels at NFT-specific classes (Public_Burn F1=0.507) but misses reentrancy (0.000); AugScan-v2 detects reentrancy perfectly but struggles with Public_Burn (0.000) and Unlimited_Minting (0.091)
API efficiency: NFT-AugScan-v2 uses ~7.8 calls/contract vs 69 for NFT-Scan (8.8x reduction) while achieving +6.8% higher macro F1
